# Huge new Northampton distribution centre officially opens with 150 jobs expected

By David Summers

Published 30th Sep 2026, 07:22 BST

## A huge new distribution centre covering 1.2 million square feet has officially opened in Northampton, with around 150 people expected to be employed at the site.

Yusen Logistics opened its new Sustainable Distribution Centre on Thursday, September 24, marking a major investment in the town's logistics industry.

The facility combines automated warehouse technology with a range of environmentally friendly features, including solar energy generation, rainwater harvesting and electric vehicle charging infrastructure.

It has also achieved a BREEAM Outstanding rating, one of the highest standards for sustainable building performance.

The Sustainable Distribution Centre from above, picture: SEGRO and, inset, The official ribbon cutting ceremony, picture: Faye Minister

The opening ceremony was attended by customers, business leaders, community representatives and local politicians, including Northampton South MP Mike Reader.

# Warehouse pioneers robotics system used in China

Image source, Kate Bradbrook/BBC

Image caption, Brian Luck says the Northampton warehouse is a "pioneering site" with its robotic system

By Kate Bradbrook, in Northampton and Louise Parry

27 September 2026

A new giant warehouse in England's logistics "golden triangle" is adopting pioneering technology previously only used in China, a company said.

Yusen Logistics UK said it will use a robotics and four-way conveyor system at its new site on the edge of Northampton, which will also employ hundreds of staff.

"There are some roles that robots can do better than people, but fundamentally robots don't work without people," said David Evans, the company's managing director.

The Japanese firm opened its 1.1m sq ft (102,193 sq m) site with a fusion ceremony that included a traditional counting song, sushi, and fish and chips.

# Evri invests £1.3m in new Gloucester parcel depot

 October 12, 2026 Mark Salisbury Filed under: Last Mile Deliveries, Logistics, Manufacturer News, News, Newsletter, Secondary News, Third-Party Logistics (3PL) 

Evri Group has opened a new £1.3 million depot in Gloucester, expanding its parcel delivery network across the South West and creating dozens of permanent jobs.

The new facility at Indurent Park Gloucester in Quedgeley replaces the company’s previous operation in Tewkesbury, which had reached capacity. The investment will help Evri manage rising parcel volumes, strengthen regional operations and improve its ability to meet customer demand.

The depot has created 38 permanent roles across warehouse, driving, operational and management functions. The investment also supports local employment while providing additional capacity for the growing logistics business.

results.title: Bristol Waitrose distribution centre to create hundreds of jobs as plans submitted | Bristol Live
results.author: Kate Wilson, Mantis Scribe
results.text:
Bristol Waitrose distribution centre to create hundreds of jobs as plans submitted | Bristol Live

# Bristol Waitrose distribution centre to create hundreds of jobs as plans submitted

## It will have 1,200 rooftop solar panels

News Kate Wilson Political Editor and Mantis Scribe

05:59, 12 Sep 2026

View Image

Waitrose’s first South West distribution centre to create over 550 jobs(Image: Waitrose)

Waitrose plans to open its first major distribution centre in the South West next year.

Based near Avonmouth, the giant depot will handle stock for 50 stores across the region, with operations managed on-site by logistics partner DHL.

To get the site up and running, DHL has submitted an official application to base up to 70 delivery lorries and 150 trailers at the hub, which sits on Central Avenue in Severn Beach.

The new opening is part of a nationwide £1bn upgrade by Waitrose, which includes plans for a brand-new supermarket at Bristol’s Brabazon development.

Recruitment has already started ahead of a planned opening in early 2027. The roles coming to the area include 480 warehouse workers and 80 lorry drivers.

Waitrose says the Severn Beach site is built to top-tier environment

 Plans have been submitted for a huge development by the A10 in Hertfordshire, which the applicant says would create up to 295 new jobs. 

 Specialist logistics developer Padrock has acquired the 10-acre site on Lieutenant Ellis Way, Waltham Cross, not far from the M25 junction. 

 It intends to build 205,000 sq ft of grade A multi-let industrial and logistics space across 13 units, claiming that the scheme will boast a gross development value of £110 million.

Route2 owner Joe Wall and operations manager Rodger Caldwell

Route2 Logistics has officially opened its new depot in Coatbridge, marking a major milestone in the continued growth of the specialist haulage and pallet distribution business.

Located at 8 Palacecraig Street, nestled between the M8 and M73, the new 22,000-sq ft facility provides additional warehousing, yard space and vehicle capacity, creating a significant new operational base for Route2 in the West of Scotland.

The Coatbridge depot complements Route2’s established Dunfermline operation, creating a stronger Scotland-based network and enabling the business to provide faster lead times, greater capacity and flexibility for companies delivering products to customers across Scotland.

# CEVA Logistics opens Derby distribution centre for UK eCommerce 

 

> CEVA Logistics opens Derby distribution centre for UK eCommerce 

CEVA Logistics has opened a new 508,000-square-foot distribution centre in Derby, expanding its UK contract logistics network to support growing demand from the eCommerce sector.

The facility is scheduled to become fully operational in August 2026. It will provide storage, handling and distribution services for global eCommerce customers, helping speed up deliveries across the UK.

The new operation is expected to create around 300 jobs, strengthening the regional logistics sector while supporting CEVA’s continued investment in the UK market.

The warehouse was designed with sustainability and scalability in mind. It has achieved BREEAM Excellent and EPC A+ certifications and features a rooftop solar installation to reduce energy consumption.
